patterns.about: A Lighting7 Cloud git token: a compact JWS whose header is {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"l7git"}
An ngrok authtoken by shape: <27 alphanumerics>_<21+ alphanumerics>, starting with a digit

The one-time token in a reset or device-login link: the API's /auth/reset/{token}, and the page's /reset/{token} at the start of a path or after a host — never a path that merely has a device segment further in, as /api/rest/surfaces/device/start would
OAuth code, state and token query parameters
